death.note: Died at the end of 840 H while heading to Mecca; buried at Badr. It appears he was dismissed before his death, as al-Walawī b. Qāsim succeeded him in 839 H.

relation.note: Took over Mashyakhat al-Khuddām at al-Madīna al-Nabawiyya after Fayrūz al-Ruknī, who was summoned to Cairo, in 834 H. Fayrūz al-Ruknī = AIND-D06199 (Fīrūz al-Rūmī al-Ruknī, of the servant corps). Replaces mis-pointed TMP-P-000555 (= al-Ṣalāḥ al-Ṭarābulusī).
Succeeded by al-Walawī b. Qāsim in 839 H. al-Walawī b. Qāsim = AIND-D12616 (Muḥammad b. Qāsim b. ʿAbd Allāh, ابن قاسم الولوي). Replaces mis-pointed TMP-P-000556 (= Dāwūd al-Hawwārī).

event.note: Heading to Mecca when he died.

state.note: Head of the (eunuch) servants of the Prophet's Mosque in Medina. New TMP-O-00093 (replaces mis-pointed TMP-O-00078 = Tawqīʿ al-Ḥukm).

person.note: バシール・サアド・アッ＝ディーン・アッ＝タナミー・アッ＝タワーシー（宦官）。834年にカイロへ召喚されたフィールーズ・アッ＝ルクニー（D06199）の後任として、預言者の町マディーナの給仕長職（マシュヤハ・アル＝フッダーム）に就いた。840年末、マッカへ向かう途中で亡くなり、バドルに埋葬された。839年にアル＝ワラウィー・ブン・カーシム（D12616）が後任となっており、死の前に免職されたとみられる。

Bashīr Saʿd al-Dīn al-Tanamī al-Ṭawāshī (a eunuch). He took over the office of head of the servants (mashyakhat al-khuddām) at al-Madīna al-Nabawiyya after Fayrūz al-Ruknī, who had been summoned to Cairo, in 834 H. He died at the end of 840 H while heading to Mecca and was buried at Badr. It appears he was dismissed before his death, as al-Walawī b. Qāsim succeeded him in 839 H.
